name: Jiwoo
source:
He is a prodigy in chemistry. He is intelligent, arrogant and sleazy. He can make his own home-made concoctions.

He is one of the chief chemists at Molecula Corp. He used to live with his uncle until he killed him under a suspicion of being infected, and tucked his mutilated corpse in the closet after.
